components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Tactile pill button with active press scaling and hover accent border
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #c9d2f7; color: #02286e; border: 1px solid #02286e; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 16px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: #0a6fe3; color: #0a6fe3; background: rgba(10, 111, 227, 0.1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

narrative.overview: The visual language balances technical precision with friendly, tactile warmth. Grounded in deep celestial blues with luminous amber accents, the interface combines frosted glassmorphism, responsive ambient glows, and snappy micro-interactions that make every tap feel immediate and rewarding.
keyCharacteristics: Layered ambient depth through subtle backdrop glows that adapt between light and dark themes.
Tactile, physics-inspired press feedback (scale(0.97)) on all interactive triggers.
High-contrast, expressive typography pairing Fredoka display headings with Figtree body text.
Glassmorphism containers with subtle borders and balanced internal padding.

rules.name: The High Contrast Rule
rules.body: Text highlights must always maintain WCAG AAA contrast against both light glass backgrounds and dark atmospheric surfaces.

rules.name: The Glass and Border Rule
rules.body: Every elevated card or dock combines translucent backgrounds with subtle hairline borders.

dos: Do maintain bilingual translations (es / en) for all new UI copy.
Do use @tabler/icons-astro components directly with stroke="currentColor".
Do include tactile press states (active:scale-[0.97]) on clickable UI elements.
Do preserve glassmorphism borders on translucent cards.
donts: Don't add artificial pulsating badges or generic AI aesthetic clichés.
Don't import raw SVG files into src/assets/icons/.
Don't use opaque flat containers that obstruct the ambient lighting background.
